item.title: REDWOODS VERSUS SEQUOIAS
item.description: Redwoods in California's coastal mountains get more of the glory including being the official state tree. But redwoods are babes and petite in terms of girth and age compared to their giant sequoia cousins in the Sierra.

item.title: ROUNDUP: Five local wrestlers take 1st at Halter Memorial
item.description: Returning state-meet qualifiers Valeria Galvan and Liliana Rios won division titles in the 48th annual Halter Memorial Wrestling Tournament this past Saturday at Sonora High.

item.title: Lathrop promotes from within to fill head coaching vacancy
item.description: Lathrop isn’t ready to make any sweeping changes to its football program coming off an historic run under coach Ryan Teicheira. The decision makers did not need to look far to find his successor.

item.title: Public utility box art: A wonderful idea & good start, but Manteca still needs to do a lot more
item.description: The City of Art. Manteca? Why not? It’s a legitimate aspiration. And it’s not a Johnny-Come-Lately idea. Back in 1996, graffiti was a rampant problem in Manteca. Kirt Giovannoni, a now retired art teacher, started what was to be referred to as “the mural project” at Manteca High. The goal was to counter teens’ urge to do graffiti. item.title: Lathrop reviewing 244-unit project featuring motor court homes
item.description: Village 4 by Van Daele is multi-family development that’s part of Phase 2 plan of River Islands at Lathrop.

item.title: LEARNING ABOUT MLK JR.
item.description: Students from the Manteca Unified School District honored the memory of Dr. Martin Luther King. Jr. this past week.

item.title: Ripon increasing garbage rates 20% starting in February
item.description: Ripon’s solid waste rates are increasing 20 percent in February. It is part of overall municipal utility charges — water, sewer, and solid waste — going up to $134.79 a month from the current $123.10 starting next month.

item.title: 665,000+ square feet of distribution space planned for Harlan Road
item.description: The former Bosie Cascade building material supply operation on Harlan Road is proposed to be replaced with more than 665,000 square feet of additional distribution center space.

item.title: HOPE Shelters placed 75% of clients in 2025 into permanent housing
item.description: HOPE Ministries managed to find permanent housing for a record-high 75 percent of the 225 people the non-profit assisted with temporary shelter during 2025.

item.title: MANTECA INCREASING RANK OF FIREFIGHTERS BY 20 PERCENT
item.description: Manteca’s firefighter ranks will grow by an unprecedented 20 percent this year. And it is thanks in a large part to voter approval of Measure Q in November 2024.
